name: sentry
title: Error monitoring (Sentry)
description: Sentry for server, edge and browser errors, React error boundaries and request errors, tunnelled through your own domain; inert until a DSN is set.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN
env.description: Project DSN. Unset = Sentry stays off

env.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Build-time token to upload source maps (readable stack traces)

env.name: SENTRY_ORG
env.description: Organization slug, for source map upload

env.name: SENTRY_PROJECT
env.description: Project slug, for source map upload

postInstall: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN to start reporting. Add SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG and SENTRY_PROJECT in CI for readable stack traces.
